allowed_generator_inputs: operational substrate/process primitives already earned by AJ1-AJ5
forbidden_generator_inputs: post-outcome family classifier feedback into search

required_separation.posthoc_adjudication: may read frozen benchmark only after candidate generation and capability/resource evaluation are frozen
required_separation.selection_prediction: if PREDICTED_SELECTED is claimed, the pre-search prediction must state an architecture-name-free structural pressure and operating regime before outcome reveal

outcome_semantics.COMPILED: family recipe/known target structure was deliberately constructed; not blind recovery
outcome_semantics.RECOVERED: family-hidden search generated a candidate that passes the frozen posthoc fingerprint and observation tests
outcome_semantics.PREDICTED_SELECTED: before search, GMI predicted architecture-name-free pressures/regime selecting that fingerprint; family-hidden search then recovered it
outcome_semantics.NOT_RECOVERED_AT_SCOPE: registered search/evidence budget ended without a candidate satisfying the frozen fingerprint; must be preserved as a scientific result

minimum_search_robustness_for_flagship: two materially different lower presentations or semantics-preserving encodings
two materially different search procedures under a common declared objective/budget frame
raw resource/Pareto accounting before optional scalarization
